candidates.change_summary: Change the conditional to trigger payout on random == 1 instead of random == 0, causing pot to be reset in the opposite random case.
Remove the pot reset so that after a winning branch pot is not set to zero, leaving pot unchanged after payout.
Move the pot increment to after the random check so that pot may not include the current ticket when payout occurs, changing observed pot value after play.

Change the fee transfer amount to zero so pot after play differs because less is transferred out (pot reset still occurs), affecting final pot when pot reset removed previously or in certain sequences.
Change the require to accept any msg.value so pot may accumulate different amounts and observed pot after play can differ when callers send non-standard amounts.
Change randomness modulus from 2 to 3 so pot distribution condition (random==0) occurs with different frequency, altering pot after play().
Change the fee transfer target from bank to msg.sender so fee is sent back to player, altering pot after play().
Remove resetting pot to zero after payout so pot retains value after play(), changing observed pot.
Require different ticket amount (TICKET_AMOUNT + 1) so require may revert or accept different payments, affecting pot after play().
Move pot increment after randomness and conditional so pot is not included in payout on winning play(), altering observed pot.
